## Checklist

- [ ] Title is a [Conventional Commit](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/) (`feat:`, `fix:`, `docs:`, `test:`, `refactor:`, `chore:`, `ci:`, `perf:`)
- [ ] Tests added or updated (bug fixes include a regression test that fails on the old code)
- [ ] Test suite stays offline (`pytest` passes with no network)
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated for user-visible changes
- [ ] `skills/source-to-skill/SKILL.md` kept lean (net additions justified)
